denominators.known_rules: Extracted known-rule SME verification is a separate metric, never total modernization percentage.
denominators.line_verification_percent: Verified applicable in-scope physical lines / all applicable in-scope physical lines. Blocked and unverified lines remain in the denominator.
denominators.semantic_units: Rules share one stable unit across their source span; layouts and unsupported lines remain distinct units. This is not a count of all possible legacy business rules.
denominators.source_lines: All frozen exported physical lines, including non-executable and explicitly out-of-scope lines.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ELIGIBLE.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
COPY LAYOUT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING CUSTOMER-RECORD REFERRAL-RECORD.
  IF AGE >= 18
    MOVE "Y" TO DECISION
  ELSE
    MOVE "N" TO DECISION
  END-IF.
  IF ACTIVE = "N"
    MOVE "N" TO DECISION
  ELSE
    CONTINUE
  END-IF.
  IF CUSTOMER-ID <> REF-CUSTOMER-ID
    MOVE "N" TO DECISION
  ELSE
    CONTINUE
  END-IF.
  IF AMOUNT > 50000
    MOVE "R" TO DECISION
  ELSE
    CONTINUE
  END-IF.
  GOBACK.

01 CUSTOMER-RECORD.
  05 CUSTOMER-ID PIC 9(4).
  05 AGE PIC 9(3).
  05 ACTIVE PIC X.
01 REFERRAL-RECORD.
  05 REF-CUSTOMER-ID PIC 9(4).
  05 AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
  05 DECISION PIC X.
